name: Beeptune Tales - Spin City
source:
The world has changed.

In the heart of Spin City lives Jess, Griswald, and Jaxo. Strange happenings threaten their peaceful way of life--it's up to them to get to the bottom of it.

[From [url=https://shapeshiftgl.itch.io/bt-spin-city]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
世界已经改变。

杰西、格里斯瓦尔德和贾克索住在旋转城的中心。奇怪的事件威胁着他们平静的生活方式——他们必须找出真相。

[来自[url=https://shapeshiftgl.itch.io/bt-spin-city]Itch.io[/url]]
